DEMANDOPERATIONALFORECAST OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_POE10 10% probability of exceedance operational demand forecast value OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_POE50 50% probability of exceedance operational demand forecast value OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_POE90 90% probability of exceedance operational demand forecast value 37 The published Operational Demand (Actual and Forecast) csv files can be found at https://www.aemo.com.au/energy-systems/electricity/national- electricity-market-nem/data-nem/operational-demand-data.
